score.same_pattern: 1 if both ids are in the same rules.json patterns list, else 0
score.cosine: Cosine similarity of the two 19-value muscles vectors, in the order of exercises.json muscles. 0 if either vector is all zeros.
score.mean_abs_diff: Mean of |cur[m] - cand[m]| over the muscles the current exercise rates >= 0.5. If none, use its single highest-rated muscle.
score.rounding: Round the score to 2 decimals. Sort by score descending, then by id ascending to break ties.

exclude: the candidate has the same id as the current exercise
equipment_filter: The toggle is a set of families to keep. If it's empty or all families are on, nothing is filtered. Otherwise drop candidates whose family isn't in the set before ranking, then take the top 6 of what's left. The current exercise is never filtered out of the board.

tags.order: Evaluate in this order and keep the first 2 that apply.

rules.when: The candidate is in stretch_biased[primary muscle of the current exercise] and the current exercise isn't. The primary muscle is the current exercise's highest-rated muscle; ties go to the first in muscles order.
The families differ and the candidate is in the machine, free or bodyweight family. Use the tag for the candidate's family.
The families match and the equipment strings are equal.
|cand[m] - cur[m]| >= 0.25, and either cur[m] >= 0.5 or cand[m] >= 0.75. Biggest difference first. Show the muscle key with underscores replaced by spaces.

custom.scoring: Use the same formula with the custom exercise's own ratings. same_pattern uses its optional `pattern` field, and counts as 0 when the field is missing. Family comes from its equipment string.
custom.note: Show the badge 'est.' on custom candidates because their ratings are user estimates. They are ranked together with library exercises and follow the same equipment filter and tags. Fixes in rules.json never pick a custom exercise.
